questions.stem_text:
Statement 1| The BLEU metric uses precision, while the ROGUE metric uses recall. Statement
2| Hidden markov models were frequently used to model English sentences.
questions.answer_explanation: The BLEU metric indeed focuses on precision in evaluating machine translation by comparing n-grams between the generated and reference texts, while the ROGUE metric emphasizes recall by assessing the overlap of n-grams, and Hidden Markov Models have historically been employed to represent and analyze the structure of English sentences.

questions.stem_text: The disadvantage of Grid search is

options.A: It can not be applied to non-differentiable functions.
options.B: It can not be applied to non-continuous functions.
options.D: It runs reasonably slow for multiple linear regression.

questions.answer_explanation: The correct answer highlights that Grid search evaluates every combination of hyperparameters systematically, leading to slower performance, especially in complex models like multiple linear regression that may have numerous parameters to tune.

questions.stem_text: The computational complexity of Gradient Descent is polynomial in the number of features, D.
questions.answer_explanation: The computational complexity of Gradient Descent is polynomial in the number of features, D, because each iteration of the algorithm requires computing the gradient with respect to all D features, leading to a complexity of O(D) per iteration, and the number of iterations is typically bounded, resulting in a total complexity that is polynomial in D.

questions.stem_text: Applying an L 1 norm regularization penalty in linear regression can lead to some coefficients being zeroed out.
questions.answer_explanation: Applying an L1 norm regularization penalty, also known as Lasso regression, encourages sparsity in the model by adding a constraint that can shrink some coefficients to exactly zero, effectively performing variable selection.

questions.stem_text: Residual connections are utilized in both ResNets and Transformers to improve learning efficiency and model performance.
questions.answer_explanation: Residual connections help mitigate the vanishing gradient problem and enable more effective information flow in deep networks, which enhances learning efficiency and overall model performance in both ResNets and Transformers.

questions.stem_text: The model obtained through forward stage wise selection may differ from the final model after identifying the subset of features.
questions.answer_explanation: The model obtained through forward stagewise selection may differ from the final model because forward selection increments features one at a time based on their individual contribution, while the final model may involve a combination of features chosen based on their collective interaction and performance.

questions.stem_text: To achieve the same projection in PCA as SVD, it is essential to transform the data to have a zero mean.
questions.answer_explanation: Transforming the data to have a zero mean is essential in PCA because it ensures that the principal components accurately represent the directions of maximum variance, which aligns with the singular value decomposition (SVD) process that also centers the data.
